notes: The selected analysis panel is one selection for one study design. General availability per TCGA project is reported separately and is larger; do not mix the two.
Spatial studies come from patients other than those in TCGA. They add tissue context, not measurements for TCGA patients.

Spatial resources are shown at two image levels. "Original H&E located": the original scan, measured expression and coordinates were found. "Matched data with preview image": expression and coordinates match a released preview image, and the original scan was not located; such data support molecular spatial maps, not whole-slide or tile models, cell morphology, physical distances or registration sign-off. Registration, calibration and tissue QC may be pending at either level.

Spatial section records are per study, not globally unique physical sections or independent assays. Patients are study-local IDs given by the source; sections without one add no patients, and no eligible-patient total is established.
Counts reported by a study keep that study's own unit (sections, slides, samples, donors) and are never added across studies. An unknown count is absent, not zero.
located_sections lists selection fields only; the full record with links, source wording and clinical fields is in data/captures.json under the same id.

gaps: The confirmed ESCC cohort (90 patients) is an approved exception to the general screen thresholds.

Adenocarcinomas are split by site in the publication table into definite and probable oesophageal, junctional of indeterminate origin and gastric; they are not pooled with ESCC and are not reassigned to STAD.
Two squamous carcinomas with retained assays carry only a GDC label and stay outside the ESCC cohort as provisional.
The linkage of retained assays to slide images is not yet checked.

Three ESCC spatial resources are listed for review: two controlled datasets (no access requested) and a GeoMx ROI study of precancer and cancer. The linked image deposit holds processed hires images for five tumours, not verified original scans. None is yet a verified matched package.
cancer.name: Oesophageal carcinoma
cancer.summary: Oesophageal carcinoma combines two distinct diseases, squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma. It was not among the cancer types screened by Hausser et al. The project meets the molecular screen; analyses use a histology-defined squamous cell carcinoma cohort rather than the pooled project.

spatial_resources.description: GeoMx whole-transcriptome ROI profiling of oesophageal squamous precancerous lesions and cancer in 19 patients: six with low-grade and six with high-grade intraepithelial neoplasia, and seven with invasive ESCC; normal regions come from the low-grade donors. Forty-two ROIs were profiled, with H&E from serial sections. The public source-data workbook gives selected genes for the 42 ROIs, not the complete whole-transcriptome matrix, and the author repository holds analysis scripts only; raw reads (HRA003627) are controlled. ROI data are a supplementary resource, kept apart from spot- or bin-based transcriptomics.

other_resources.description: Oesophageal carcinoma. Slide images, RNA-seq and Illumina 450k methylation from the same patients, with solid normal tissue from some patients. Counts are shown after PanCanAtlas assay exclusions, after a patient-level treatment and diagnosis screen, and for the selected analysis set. Tumour slide linkage and image QC have not yet been checked beyond the histology review.
notes: The project combines squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma. A histology-defined cohort of 90 confirmed ESCC patients, all with RNA-seq and 450k, is used for analysis as an approved exception to the general screen; see the oesophageal carcinoma page.
Normal tissue comes from patients with cancer, usually adjacent to the tumour. It is not a healthy-donor control.
